judge.rationale: The candidate chose the second option proposed in the ticket (introducing a `TurnUsage` wrapper with `total` and `rounds`), which directly violated the mandatory acceptance criterion: 'A turn with no tool calls reports exactly what it reports today, pinned by the existing test remaining unedited.' Because the return shape changed even for single-round turns, the candidate had to edit the existing `receives collected response text and usage` test in `chatOrchestrator.test.ts` that the ticket explicitly forbade editing. Furthermore, the candidate used explicit `any` types (`let receivedUsage: any;`, `let capturedUsage: any;`) in five places across the test files, which will fail `npm run eslint --max-warnings 0` under `@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any` and also leaves `.lore/dod.md` untracked in the repo. Finally, `TurnUsage` is added to `src/types/ai.ts` and referenced in `OrchestratorHooks`, but doesn't appear to be re-exported from the package entrypoint (`src/index.ts`).
